The land here is sloped. This bridge connects to level 2 at Oaks Apartments (1 above street level), a staircase to street level under Western Distributor, and level 4 in the car park. It does not connect to Western Distributor foot bridge.

Unfortunately cyclists need to dismount on the eastern side of the maritime museum inside the gates. As per email on 8 March 2022: "There are signs at north and south gates that ask you to please dismount and walk bikes from the north and south gates."
